name: Tris Cough Syrup
description:
Buy Tris Cough Syrup Online

Buy Tris Cough Syrup Online has announced the introduction of its promethazine and codeine syrup promethazine HCl and codeine phosphate oral solution. Tris’ promethazine and codeine syrup is available in 16-oz. bottles in dosage strengths of 6.25 mg and 10 mg per 5-ml oral solution.

Furthermore, The drug is indicate for temporary relief of coughs and uppers respiratory system associate with allergies or the common cold in patients 18 years of age and older.

Tris Cough Syrup Online

Promethazine Hydrochloride And Codeine Phosphate with NDC 27808-065 is a a human prescription drug product labeled by Tris Pharma Inc. The generic name of Promethazine Hydrochloride And Codeine Phosphate is promethazine hydrochloride and codeine phosphate.

The product’s dosage form is solution and is administer via oral form. Promethazine HCl and Codeine Phosphate Oral Solution is not recommend for use in pregnant women.

Tris Cough Syrup Review

Prolong use of Promethazine HCl and Codeine Phosphate Oral Solution during pregnancy can result in neonatal opioid withdrawal syndrome,

Finally, which may be life-threatening if not recognize and treate, and requires management according to protocols develope by neonatology experts.

If Promethazine HCl and Codeine

Phosphate Oral Solution is use for a prolong period in a pregnant woman,

advise the patient of the risk of neonatal opioid withdrawal syndrome and ensure that appropriate treatment will be available.
